taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: Coupon Taxi, Yellow Metered Taxi and Regular Metered Taxi operate at NAIA. An airport staff member gives passengers a dispatch slip: keep it yourself and do not hand it to the driver. For questions or complaints about the ride, use the contact numbers on the slip.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Terminal parking is first come, first served, without advance reservations. Cars can be left overnight or for several days; long-term parking is charged for each 24-hour period. Cash, GCash, PayMaya and bank cards are accepted.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi-Fi is available in all NAIA terminals: GLOBE’s NAIA Free Go Wi-Fi for 3 hours a day, Smart for 1 hour a day and Converge for 2 hours a day. The airport page lists check-in, boarding gate, arrivals and departures areas. In Terminals 1 and 2, laptop charging is in the departures area after security; phone charging is also available in the public area.
